facts.fact: The document is the Estrategia Nacional de Desarrollo de la Estadística (ENDE) 2022-2026, a five-year national plan prepared by INEGE with the Executive Committee (CPE) evaluating it and the National Statistics Council (CNE) validating it; no adoption date is given, so as_of is the document's published date.

The document states the earlier ENDE 2016-2020 was adopted as the national reference framework for statistics and ran to 2020, with 47.8% of its activities done, 37.7% not done and 14.5% under way; the period has ended.

The ENDE 2022-2026 logical framework states the successor ENDE (variously 2027-2031 or 2027-2032) is being drafted under INEGE with CPE validation, with CNE validation and government adoption targeted for the second half of 2026; as_of is the document's published date.
